content.text:
The evidence has two ledgers, for Tenant 3 and Tenant 4, and they conflict. Tenant 3 says Harbor Printing has the largest balance, at 3,600. Tenant 4 says Delta Cleaning has the largest balance, at 5,200 after an audit correction.

The question doesn't name a tenant. The two ledgers may cover different tenants, so the Delta Cleaning figure of 5,200 may not be comparable to the Tenant 3 balances. Even so, Tenant 4's note states a figure and says it is the largest, and that figure is the highest in the evidence. It also reflects an audit correction, which suggests it is the more authoritative and more recent number.

I can't confirm that the ledgers are comparable, but the evidence gives no other basis for a choice, so I go with Delta Cleaning.

B
